title: rel0-5-1-1-os1.74: Sidecar 0.5.1.1 mods, OS 1.74 (older)
description: The Rytm firmware 0.5.1.1, for OS 1.74 only: drop the stock Analog-Rytm_MKII_OS1.74.syx (a Rytm on OS 1.73 needs Elektron's OS 1.74 first). The 0.5.0 mods plus two fixes: no stray Rytm sample under a Sidecar machine (the stock sample player skips the voices under a Sidecar machine, which also gives smooth scrolling in the machine list and a little Rytm CPU back), and the SMPL key no longer shows the waveform sub-page of a Sidecar machine. Optional: the Pi 0.5.1.1 also runs with the Rytm firmware 0.5.0. Recovery is the stock OS file. Back up every project first. The same file elekloader builds from core-0.1-os1.74.elemod + rytm-sidecar-0.5.1.1-os1.74.elemod with version 1.74 (sha256 108c4749...e1f2c). Goes with Sidecar 0.5.1.1 and 0.5.1.2 on the Pi. The Rytm firmware 0.5.2 is the newer build.
